deals.evidence: Lerner will sell 70 percent of the Browns to Haslam now, with the other 30 percent reverting to him four years after the closing date
deals.headline: Jimmy Haslam buys the Browns from Randy Lerner
deals.summary: Pre-2015, kept as the current owners' entry: Lerner sold 70% at closing, with the other 30% passing to Haslam four years later. Forbes gives the price paid as $987M.

deals.evidence: the stadium project receives the $600 million as a "performance grant" towards the stadium
deals.headline: Ohio budget gives $600m to the Browns' enclosed stadium in Brook Park
deals.summary: Ohio's budget includes a $600m 'performance grant' toward a new enclosed Huntington Bank Field in Brook Park, repaid from incremental revenue; the Haslams describe a $2bn+ stadium and mixed-use investment with private development partners and Haslam Sports Group covers overruns.

ownership_summary: Owned by Dee and Jimmy Haslam (Haslam Sports Group), Managing and Principal Partners since buying the team from Randy Lerner in 2012 (70% at closing, the remaining 30% four years later); JW Johnson and Whitney Haslam Johnson are managing partners. Haslam Sports Group is building a new enclosed stadium in Brook Park. No institutional minority stake is reported.
